title: Jellyfish in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='dome' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3e6'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e066c9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b03fa8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tent' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ad8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cf5fbf'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tentacles -->
  <path d='M34 62 Q30 74 36 84 Q40 78 36 70' fill='none' stroke='url(#tent)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 64 Q40 78 46 90 Q50 82 46 72' fill='none' stroke='url(#tent)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 64 Q60 78 54 90 Q50 82 54 72' fill='none' stroke='url(#tent)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 62 Q70 74 64 84 Q60 78 64 70' fill='none' stroke='url(#tent)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 64 Q50 82 50 92' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ad8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- dome body -->
  <path d='M22 58 Q22 22 50 22 Q78 22 78 58 Q74 62 70 58 Q66 62 62 58 Q58 62 54 58 Q50 62 46 58 Q42 62 38 58 Q34 62 30 58 Q26 62 22 58 Z' fill='url(#dome)' stroke='#ffd1f0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- dome highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffe0f5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='34' r='3' fill='#ffe0f5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d='M23 57 Q50 66 77 57 Q77 64 50 72 Q23 64 23 57 Z' fill='#ffcf3f' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='5' fill='#f5b820' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M64 70 Q70 80 66 92 Q72 86 72 78 Q74 72 66 68 Z' fill='#ffcf3f' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M67 78 Q70 84 68 90' fill='none' stroke='#e0a010' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little face -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='45' r='3' fill='#5a1a55'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='45' r='3' fill='#5a1a55'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffd1f0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffd1f0'/>
  <path d='M46 51 Q50 55 54 51' fill='none' stroke='#5a1a55' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fcb' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fcb' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
